activity.role: Poet and author of the Metamorphoses
activity.notes: Circa 8 CE marks the near-completion of the Metamorphoses before the exile to Tomis. This is a representative late-Roman literary point, not an asserted exact publication day, full-year residence, or exile-begins composition date. Columbia dates composition approximately 2–8 CE. Publius Ovidius Naso is the Roman poet, not the medical literature service Ovid or any mythic character. Rome is the pre-exile cultural locus; do not treat the narrative geography as author residence. Later exile poetry is noted without forcing a precise death year (17/18 CE) into the Activity.
